text_block_list.text:
The long-awaited "Takarazuka Kinen" has 
finally arrived.

Having finished her preparations and 
stepped out of the waiting room, Grass 
Wonder's expression looked brighter than 
before.

Determined to forge her own path with 
unwavering resolve... she headed off to 
the race where her formidable rival, 
Special Week, awaited.
